dialog.cvDeployNotice1: Complex Workflows: ComfyUI is recommended but has a steep learning curve. Search for tutorials on Bilibili/YouTube first.
dialog.cvDeployNotice2: Model Weights: Download from Civitai or HuggingFace and place in the models directory.
dialog.vramWarningOom: Insufficient VRAM. Forced loading will cause Out of Memory (OOM) crash. Switch to 'Free Cloud' tab.

engineGuides.Ollama: Run the command in terminal to auto-download and run the model
engineGuides.LM Studio: Open the app, search for the model name, and download the GGUF format
engineGuides.ComfyUI: Place model files in models/checkpoints directory, then refresh the UI
engineGuides.Transformers: Install transformers via pip, then load the model
engineGuides.WebUI: Place model files in models/Stable-diffusion directory, then select in UI
engineGuides.vLLM: Run vllm serve command, supports OpenAI-compatible API
engineGuides.Stability Matrix: One-click install and manage multiple image generation tools
